tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: The countries Every Room covers, with how many homes are for sale and to rent in each, the currency, and which filters work there. Call this first to get the two-letter market codes the other tools take.

tools.name: find_area
tools.description: Turn a place name into the area slugs search_listings filters on, with how many homes each area has. Example: country "ae", text "marina" finds dubai-marina.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search homes for sale or to rent in one market. Returns 24 listings a page, newest first unless sorted, with price, size, rooms, place and a photo. Up to 4 pages per search: narrow with filters rather than paging. Prices filter in euros: the sale price, or the rent per month (also in markets that qu

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Everything public about one listing: title, description, all photos, price, size, rooms, place and similar homes. Seller contact is not included.

tools.name: compare_listings
tools.description: Two to six listings side by side: price, euros per square metre, size, rooms, place and age of the ad.

tools.name: my_account
tools.description: The signed-in person's Every Room account: their plan and how many seller reveals are left this week, their shortlists and their saved searches. Needs sign-in.

tools.name: save_listing
tools.description: Save a listing to one of the person's shortlists, the same lists the heart on evryroom.com saves to. Without `list`, it goes to their first list (made for them if they have none); a `list` name that does not exist yet becomes a new list. Needs sign-in.

tools.name: remove_saved_listing
tools.description: Take a listing out of the person's shortlists: out of the named `list`, or out of every list of theirs that holds it. Needs sign-in.

tools.name: my_saved_listings
tools.description: The listings in the person's shortlists, newest first: every list, or only the one named. Needs sign-in.

tools.name: save_search
tools.description: Save a search under a name, with the same filters as search_listings. It appears in the person's saved searches on evryroom.com. Needs sign-in.

tools.name: my_saved_searches
tools.description: The person's saved searches, newest first, each with the link that reopens it. Needs sign-in.

tools.name: delete_saved_search
tools.description: Delete one of the person's saved searches by its id from my_saved_searches. Needs sign-in.

tools.name: reveal_seller
tools.description: Reveal who is selling or letting a listing: the portal or agency it is advertised on, the agent, the ad reference and the link to the original ad, plus the ad's own text.
